title: Authors without books
statementMd:
List authors who have no books in the catalogue.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.name FROM authors a LEFT JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id WHERE b.id IS NULL;
```
